raw_clinical_note: Patient: Elena Morales (MRN: 84219034, DOB: 1957-06-18, RUT: 10.482.913-K) arrived in the emergency department on 03/14/2026 with sudden severe headache, vomiting, and progressive right hemiparesis. BP 198/112 mmHg, INR 1.3 (LOINC 6301-6). Non-contrast head CT confirmed left basal ganglia intracerebral hemorrhage. Attending Dr. Marcus Vance can be reached at (555) 234-8910 or m.vance@neuroclinic.org.
